notes.title: Demonologist v1.5.1 Patch
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

Version 1.5.1 is here! This patch includes some fixes and adjustments for the latest map's exorcism to be more solo-play friendly.

notes.title: Demonologist v1.5.0 Update
notes.notes:
Hello Demonologists,

We're thrilled to announce that the update 1.5.0 is out! 

Here's what’s new:

notes.title: Demonologist v1.3.0 Update
notes.notes:
Hello Demonologists,

The update 1.3.0 is out! This new update brings the long-awaited and most wanted [b]Hiding mechanic[/b]! Along with hiding spots, the remaining [b]2 ghost data[/b] are here too! For more information and patch notes, see below:


[h2]Added:[/h2]

[list]
[*] Hiding spots added
[*] Boogey, Guipo data added
[/list]

[h2]Improved/Changed/Adjusted:[/h2]

[list]
[*] Custom mode multiplier adjusted
[*] All languages' localizations completed
[/list]

[h2]Fixes:[/h2]

[list]
[*] Safespots in all maps.
[/list]

Depending on the map's design and size, there are various hiding spots on each map. But be careful though, if the ghost sees you while you are getting inside a hiding spot, it will still catch and kill you!

And our next update after hiding spots, will be a new map "Haunted School!"

[b]Clock Wizard Games[/b]

notes.title: Demonologist v1.1.3 Patch Crash & Loading Screen Fixes
notes.notes:
Hello Demonologists, 

We are pleased to announce that the patch 1.1.3 is live! 

In this patch, we fixed the issues in certain situations that have been affecting gameplay and bothering our players. Our development team has been working hard on the main issues for a while and we just want to say thank you for the significant feedback and patience! 

If you encounter any crashes after the patch, please refer to the: [url=https://discord.com/channels/768534220321587230/1178723291838550077]Clock Wizard Game -> Crash Minidump[/url]


[b]Fixes:[/b]

[list]
[*] Game migrated to a new engine version (5.3)(Loading into the maps for the first time might take longer than usual due to the migration into new engine version)
[*] Memory leak problem related to Render Targets
[*] Getting stuck on loading screens fixed
[*] Fixed salt barrier decreasing performance even more as the number of players around increases
[/list]

[b]Clock Wizard Games[/b]

notes.title: Demonologist v0.3.0 Update
notes.notes:
Hello!

Thank you for your patience while we deal with the influx of bug reports!

And now... 0.3.0 PATCH NOTES
[list]
[*] New purchasable tool: "Fulu Talisman" can be found in the shop! 
[*] ESG has been boosted by 10% and now includes the following voice commands: "manifest" and "show yourself"
[*] Findable lore notes have been added.
[*] Flashlight toggling has been added (default key binding: F).
[*] Text-based voice command/speech recognition has been added (default key binding: P).
[*] Single player reward boost has been increased to 1.5x.
[*] New random objectives have been added.
[*] New character hairstyles and beards have been added.
[*] Added language support: Arabic, Croatian, Serbian, Spanish (Español)
[*] New Hidden Achievement added.
[/list]

[b]NOTE: YOU MAY NEED TO RESET YOUR KEYBINDS IN ORDER TO USE THE FLASHLIGHT AND SPEECH RECOGNITION KEYS
[/b]

[b]BUG FIXES:[/b]
[list]
[*] Blurring on TVs has been reduced.
[*] Altar collision issue in Abandoned House has been fixed.
[*] Clock setting issue (Rewind/Reverse time) in Cyclone St. has been fixed.
[*] An issue where the player can not move after dying on the clock in Cyclone St. has been fixed.
[*] Some crash issues have been fixed.
[*] Minor text fixes
[/list]


Bugs being addressed with 0.3.1
[list]
[*] Flashlight toggle SOUND from the keybind is only available for the host. Players connecting to the host will not hear the toggle sound when using the keybind, but will still be able to use the flashlight. 
[*] Character walks forward if moving while picking up the note. (You can resolve this by pressing your walk key after exiting the note, or not moving when picking up the note for now.)
[*] Language: Arabic and newly added languages added have display issues in the Lost Notes (Magna, Maria Victoria, etc.)
[/list]


As always, you will need to update your game and will not be able to connect to existing users' lobbies that have not updated yet!
